2609.30151.title: Does a model's stated reason for rejecting a candidate do any work?
2609.30151.paper_summary: Asked to choose between candidates and explain the choice, a language model often rejects a rival by naming a fact its profile lacks: no director, no date of death. That sentence is a claim about the text in front of the model, and it can be tested without any judge. We insert a real corpus sentence stating the named fact into the rival's profile and ask again under greedy decoding. Two controls separate content from placement: a length-matched irrelevant sentence at the same profile, and the same two sentences at a third option the model never mentioned. In the largest of three runs, six open models on 2WikiMultihopQA, supplying the named fact at the profile the model named moves its choice more than the irrelevant control does, odds ratio 3.57 [1.54, 8.26], Holm p=0.0210, and this survives dropping any single model. The contrast the design was built to detect, the same fact at the option nobody named, does not clear correction, Holm p=0.2428. The strongest result in the family carries no content claim at all: the identical irrelevant sentence moves the choice more at the named rival than at the third option, Holm p=0.0008. Repair and control also differ in co-candidate mentions, relation template and fluency; post-hoc matching on the first two preserves the content effects' direction, matching fluency weakens one, so the content contrasts bound an effect rather than establish one. A forced single-token probability read disagrees in direction with the free-text choice on that same contrast, and three candidate explanations for the disagreement find no support. Every measurement is a string rule, so each was validated against the records it reads; validation caught eight defects. The largest, a choice-parsing rule that returned the option a model had just rejected in 17.1% of adjudicable responses, would have reported six surviving contrasts instead of four.
2609.30151.paper_summary_zh: 被要求在候選人之間做選擇並解釋該選擇時，語言模型通常會通過指出其資料庫缺少的事實來拒絕對手：沒有導演，沒有死亡日期。那句話是對模型面前文本的主張，可以在沒有任何評判者的情況下進行測試。我們將一個聲明該事實的真實語料句子插入對手的資料庫中，並在貪婪解碼下再次詢問。兩個控制條件將內容與位置分開：一個與資料庫長度匹配的無關句子，和在模型從未提及的第三選項中的相同兩個句子。在三次運行中最大的那一次，六個開放模型在2WikiMultihopQA上，提供模型所提及的資料庫中的事實，使其選擇的變化超過了無關控制的變化，賠率比為3.57 [1.54, 8.26]，Holm p=0.0210，並且這在去掉任何單一模型後仍然成立。設計旨在檢測的對比，即在沒有人提到的選項中的相同事實，未能通過修正，Holm p=0.2428。該系列中最強的結果根本不帶有內容主張：相同的無關句子在提到的對手中比在第三選項中更能影響選擇，Holm p=0.0008。修復和控制在共同候選人提及、關係模板和流暢度上也有所不同；對前兩者的事後匹配保留了內容效應的方向，匹配流暢度削弱了一個，因此內容對比界定了一個效應，而不是建立一個。強制的單標記概率讀取在該對比的方向上與自由文本選擇不一致，對該不一致的三個候選解釋沒有找到支持。每個測量都是一條字符串規則，因此每個都經過其所讀取記錄的驗證；驗證發現了八個缺陷。最大的缺陷是一條選擇解析規則，在17.1%的可裁定回應中返回模型剛剛拒絕的選項，這本應報告六個存活的對比而不是四個。
2609.30151.author: Archit Rastogi et.al.
